bounds.honest_note: Reader max over the whole sweep was 93.6 ms (0 of 72,055 samples over 100 ms) after the date rewrite was sliced. The writer probe (one record replaced every 20 ms, same process) peaked at 406.9 ms once in 7,215 samples during the bars phase (disk and interpreter contention with the parquet rewrite); inside the snapshot delete window it peaked at 76.7 ms. The snapshot writer lock is held only by the delete transactions (8.5 ms each), so the 250 ms writer bound is a lock bound; the one 407 ms outlier is not lock wait and is reported, not hidden.
